eras.note: New Jersey's 40 legislative districts are shared between chambers — each elects 2 Assembly members + 1 Senator from identical boundaries. NJ state legislative elections are odd-year; not on the 2026 ballot (next: 2027). Senate terms follow an unusual 2-4-4 year pattern each decade (a 2-year term right after redistricting, then two 4-year terms) — all 40 seats are elected together each time, not staggered.
